messages.subject: How are the data permuted for the ezPerm interaction term?
messages.subject_clean: How are the data permuted for the ezPerm interaction term?
messages.body_plain:
Dear Mike and ez users,

thank you for the ez package, it has made my analyses a lot easier!

I'm trying to figure out a way to run a permutation test for an interaction of a between and a within factor. I'm aware of the warning about the interaction term in ezPerm but was wondering if it happened to be correct in my design. So, I would really appreciate information on how the interaction is calculated and especially how the data are permuted. I've had a look at the code but couldn't figure it out since I'm new R and programming in general.

Thanks very much!

Best regards,

Ilkka Järvinen
